name: Monarch Money
author: Rune Weaver Community
description: Query accounts, balances, transactions, budgets, cashflow, and holdings, or update transactions and budgets via Monarch Money.

tools.name: monarch.accounts
tools.description: Fetch Monarch Money accounts, total balances, institution statuses, and optionally investment holdings.

account_id.description: Optional specific account ID to fetch holdings for.

include_holdings.description: Whether to fetch detailed investment security holdings. Default is false.

tools.name: monarch.transactions
tools.description: Query Monarch Money transactions with filtering, or retrieve details/splits for a specific transaction, or list all transaction categories and tags.

search.description: Text search query for merchant name or notes.

start_date.description: Start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format.

category_ids.description: List of category IDs to filter by.

account_ids.description: List of account IDs to filter by.

limit.description: Max number of transactions to return (default: 50, max: 200).

transaction_id.description: If provided, fetches details and splits for this specific transaction.

list_categories.description: If true, lists all available transaction categories and tags instead of transactions.

tools.name: monarch.finances
tools.description: Retrieve financial reports from Monarch Money: budgets, cashflow summaries, recurring transactions, or savings goals.

start_date.description: Start date for budgets/cashflow in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date for budgets/cashflow in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: monarch.mutate
tools.description: Perform write operations in Monarch Money (update or create transactions, update tags, adjust budget amounts, or trigger account refreshes). Always approval-gated.

transaction_id.description: Target transaction ID for update_transaction or set_transaction_tags.

account_id.description: Target account ID for create_transaction or refresh_accounts.

category_id.description: Category ID for update_transaction, create_transaction, or set_budget_amount.

merchant_name.description: Merchant name for update_transaction or create_transaction.

amount.description: Amount for transaction creation/update (negative for expense, positive for income) or budget amount.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format for create_transaction, update_transaction, or set_budget_amount.

tag_ids.description: List of tag IDs to assign for set_transaction_tags.

apply_to_future.description: When setting budget amount, apply to future months (default: false).
